behaviorChanges: The snapshot-store fault-phrase map is getattr-guarded, so the CLI imports on platforms whose errno lacks POSIX-only names (EDQUOT/ESTALE) -- previously a hard import crash on native Windows.

A legacy goalTracker.unavailablePolicy survives the provider/tracker normalization round trip in both directions (present-only; absence still means the block default), so a deliberate warn opt-down is no longer silently dropped on load.

requiredMigrations.command: gh auth refresh --hostname github.com -s read:project -s project
requiredMigrations.description: Carried forward from 0.10.3 for lanes updating across it: grant the gh token the GitHub Projects scopes the fail-closed board gates need. Machines already on 0.10.3+ or whose token carries read:project and project need no action.

rollbackNotes: Pinning back to 0.10.3 restores the direct errno attribute access (import crash on platforms lacking the names) and the round-trip key drop; no on-disk state moves in either direction.
